blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Indigenous activists and policymakers on Thursday formally launched and organized a group to monitor and assert the right to free, prior, and informed consent (FPIC) for ancestral land and ancestral domain holders across the Philippines amid encroaching developers and government projects. The FPIC Watch will also draft alternative mechanisms for government protection of indigenous rights, given recent changes to its. application that the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples had issued to relax the process and ease the certification of projects, said Joan Carling, executive director of Indigenous Rights Act International.
